newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet premiums stay soft in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet premiums stay soft in thin trade.

text.p: NWE jet fuel prices held steady on Wednesday as firmer benchmark gas oil futures countered softer barge and cargo premiums with buyers relaxed.
They said tighter supplies of gas oil in the ARA region was continuing to support the IPE gas oil futures and some saw this drawing extra demand for jet for blending but airline demand was very thin.
Barge differentials were assessed around July IPE +$15 fob ARA. Cargoes were thinly talked around July IPE +$15/$16 cif NWE.
At 1346 GMT benchmark July IPE gas oil futures were trading around $1.50 a tonne firmer at $162.25.
